_meta: G7 fragment (owner: LPRES7). Master scope 13.9c-34 (owner answers 2026-10-28): in Last Protocol the facility's Sentinel Barracks holds a 100-Sentinel reserve on top of the normal starting garrison, released in tiers as the fighting grows heavier (post refills -> quick-reaction squads of 4-8 -> breach surge; ~20% last stand held for the command centre and core rooms), automatic by default + manual from the barracks card, finite pool with a slow paid trickle. Code: sim/systems/lp_reserve7.gd. EVERY NUMBER PROVISIONAL.

g7_lpreserve._note: PROVISIONAL. size = owner's answer (100). Type mix = rules.g7_sentinels.start.force proportions without exclude_types (largest remainder): warden 30, marksman 17, gunner 13, bulwark 9, lancer 13, arc 9, mender 9. barracks_extra_slots: the LP barracks cap 120 -> 168 (WATCH7, 13.9c-38: reserve 100 + the whole 48-man garrison + 20 free for wounded coming back in; was 20 -> 140 with the 24-man garrison); skirmish barracks stay 120. The type mix follows the 48-man start.force proportions.
g7_lpreserve._fit_note: only men above fit_frac hp (not down, not EMP'd) are released; the rest heal in the barracks first
g7_lpreserve._quiet_note: a released squad comes back in to rest and refill when its sector (or the breach / core) has had no pressure for quiet_s

weights._note: pressure of one enemy = clamp(max_hp / hp_ref): a rifleman ~1, a tank / walker up to 8

post._note: tier 1: dead roster Sentinels replaced one-for-one (same type first), at most per_step a cadence

sector._note: tier 2: a wall face (n / e / w) or the gate face (s) with pressure >= heavy gets QRF squads of squad_min..squad_max while ceil(pressure x men_per_p) exceeds the men already there (cd_s between squads per face). Goals: compound-local, on the wall-walk slid towards the attackers' centre (n / e / w), the south wall-walk (s, WALLFIRE7 13.9c-35: staging yard cannot fire out); pairs pair_gap apart. Armour-heavy faces (an enemy >= armour_w) put the Lancers first.

breach._note: tier 3: enemies inside the walls (pressure >= min_p, or any once the base state is breached) -> a counter-attack surge of max(min, ceil(inside pressure x mult)) men, topped up every cd_s while the breach lasts

last_stand._note: ~20% of the reserve (same type proportions) is held in the barracks and committed only when an enemy is inside core_rect + core_r (compound-local: the core building, the command centre / planning room and the lab); it holds the core door, the command-centre door, the lab door and the lane between them

trickle._note: one replacement every every_s while the reserve is below size, the type furthest below its share, paid at the barracks' training cost x cost_mult; stops when the barracks is gone
